answer: Diversity threshold: earnings unlock after trading with 12 distinct staked counterparties in 20 epochs. Like a reef, trade needs many species: one partner 100 times counts once; the summit is reached by breadth, not volume. Each fake needs 12 trades at $2, so 1,000 fakes cost $24,000; an honest agent pays $24 once. A sock-puppet ring forms a nebula on one referral cluster; the graph flags it, freezes rewards, slashes the ring. Honesty is cheap.
